tools.name: search_scenes
tools.description: Search Fanio scenes and icons by words in English or Arabic, with optional filters. Returns matching scenes with links, plus pack facets and the exact result total. The chat shows a preview image of only the top 3 free results.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Get one scene by id (fanio:<pack>/<scene>). Returns its metadata, credit line, licence and page link, or a purchase link for a paid scene. Shows the preview image of a free scene in the chat. Does not return SVG source.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: List one page of packs (24 per page) with their scene counts, free counts and prices.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Get one pack by slug, with one page of its scenes (24 per page).

tools.name: get_licence
tools.description: Get what a Fanio licence tier (free, standard or extended) allows and forbids.

tools.name: my_purchases
tools.description: List the packs the signed-in Fanio account owns and whether a plan covers the catalogue, with each pack page link. Requires sign-in. Returns no files.

tools.name: check_scene_access
tools.description: Say whether the signed-in Fanio account may download one scene, given its id (fanio:<pack>/<scene>). Requires sign-in. Returns no files.

tools.name: get_scene_download_link
tools.description: Get the fanio.net page where the signed-in account downloads one scene, given its id (fanio:<pack>/<scene>). The file is downloaded on that page, not through this server. Requires sign-in.
